project: Sistem Intelijen Geospasial Perikanan Pelagis PPN Prigi — WPPNRI 573
phase: Phase 4.1.1 — Targeted Reconciliation, Remediation & Final Readiness Gate
final_decision_statement: GO FOR PHASE 4.2 PROTOTYPE MODULE DEVELOPMENT (DOM-DSS ACADEMIC DECISION SUPPORT SYSTEM) / STRICT NO-GO FOR OPERATIONAL FISHING NAVIGATION, AUTOMATED SEA CLOSURES, OR REGULATORY ENFORCEMENT

R-02_fleet_data_reconciliation.primary_source: Laporan Statistik Perikanan PPN Prigi 2025.xlsx — Sheet 2 (JUMLAH ARMADA PENANGKAPAN UKURAN GT)
R-02_fleet_data_reconciliation.root_cause_of_prior_55_and_1: 55 was the 2023 count for 10-<20 GT (Row 11 of Sheet 2); 1 was the December 2025 monthly trip count for >30 GT (Sheet 4); 855 was an unverified narrative number.

R-03_fisheries_metric_reconciliation.primary_source: Laporan Statistik Perikanan PPN Prigi 2025.xlsx — Sheet 5 (PRODUKSI IKAN PER SPESIES)
R-03_fisheries_metric_reconciliation.legacy_alias_preserved: total_pelagis_kg and total_pelagis_besar_kg preserved at 18,405,261 kg for backward compatibility.

R-04_spatial_aoi_and_geometry_revalidati.grid_dimensions: 50 meridional rows x 41 zonal columns = 2,050 grid centers (0.05 deg)

methods_applied: Quenouille (1952) lag-1 and Pyper & Peterman (1998) 12-lag effective sample size N_eff
Student t two-tailed p_naive and p_eff

regression_tests.name: Ensemble Weight Consistency
regression_tests.objective: Semua file RHSI memakai bobot identik dan jumlah bobot = 1.000 per spesies dengan status PROVISIONAL_ANALYST_SELECTED_WEIGHTS.
regression_tests.test_method: Cross-file equality assertion across 7 RHSI metadata, CSV, projection, sensitivity, JS bundle, and gate files.

regression_tests.name: Weighted Disagreement Formula
regression_tests.objective: Legacy species removed from TCT scope w_maxent = 0 tidak memberi kontribusi ke sigma_w pada seluruh 36.900 sel-skenario-spesies.
regression_tests.test_method: Cell-by-cell verification of sigma_w = sqrt(sum_i w_i (RHSI_i - RHSI_bar_w)^2) across 36,900 cells.

regression_tests.name: Advisory Score Separation
regression_tests.objective: weighted_mean_rhsi, weighted_ensemble_disagreement, raw_advisory_score, dan visualization_score tersimpan terpisah.
regression_tests.test_method: Schema key presence and arithmetic verification across all 36,900 projection cells.

regression_tests.name: Fleet Breakdown Consistency
regression_tests.objective: Jumlah kapal per GT (296 / 53 / 91 / 3) dan total kapal (443 pada 2025; puncak 794 pada 2016) konsisten di semua file dari sumber primer Sheet 2.
regression_tests.test_method: Cross-file equality verification against Sheet 2 of Laporan Statistik Perikanan PPN Prigi 2025.xlsx.

regression_tests.name: Fisheries Taxonomic Consistency
regression_tests.objective: Total 12 taksa (18.405.261 kg), total pelagis 10 taksa (18.070.653 kg), Gulamah (207.156 kg), Cucut (127.452 kg), dan Julung (68.906 kg) konsisten di semua file.
regression_tests.test_method: Cell-by-cell summation verification against Sheet 5 of Laporan Statistik Perikanan PPN Prigi 2025.xlsx.

regression_tests.name: April 2022 & 132-Month Series
regression_tests.objective: April 2022 = 198.246 kg, Cakalang = 122.265 kg, dan total 132 bulan = 18.405.261 kg konsisten.
regression_tests.test_method: Direct row and sum verification across 132-month series.

regression_tests.name: AOI Bounds & Grid
regression_tests.objective: Semua file spasial memakai [111.00, 113.00] x [-10.45, -8.00], 50 x 41 = 2.050 sel.
regression_tests.test_method: Bounding box and grid dimension assertion across spatial configs and seasonal grids.

regression_tests.name: Polygon Geometry Within AOI
regression_tests.objective: Semua polygon valid, tertutup, tidak self-intersecting, dan difference(AOI) = 0.0 km2.
regression_tests.test_method: 2D polygon ring validation, segment self-intersection check, and exact box difference(AOI) area calculation.

regression_tests.name: Topology & Overlap
regression_tests.objective: Overlap diuji secara terpisah sebagai within-layer interior overlap (0 di semua layer) dan cross-layer overlap matrix.
regression_tests.test_method: Pairwise interior bounding-box intersection check within each layer and cross-layer cell ID intersection matrix.

regression_tests.name: Background Points Consistency
regression_tests.objective: Jumlah titik background konsisten (5.000 titik) di semua file, 0 di luar AOI, dan 0 bertumpuk di garis batas setelah remediasi.
regression_tests.test_method: Feature count, bounding box, and boundary line coordinate inspection on target_group_background.geojson.

regression_tests.name: WPPNRI 573 Area Consistency
regression_tests.objective: Luas Sub-AOI (59.550,43 km2), rujukan nominal WPPNRI 573 (1.423.238 km2 -> 4,1842%), dan luas poligon BIG (933.749,49 km2 -> 6,3776%) konsisten di seluruh file.

actual_value.canonical_note: Sub-AOI Prigi [111.00, 113.00] E x [-10.45, -8.00] S has an exact WGS84 authalic/equal-area (EPSG:6933) surface area of 59,550.43 km2. Relative to the KKP nominal WPPNRI 573 reference area (1,423,238 km2), this is 4.1842% (4.18%). Relative to the clipped BIG polygon geometry stored in data/boundaries/wppnri_573_big.geojson (933,749.49 km2 equal-area), this is 6.3776% (6.38%).

regression_tests.test_method: WGS84 authalic equal-area integration on Sub-AOI and data/boundaries/wppnri_573_big.geojson.

regression_tests.name: Backup Manifest Integrity
regression_tests.objective: total_files_backed_up == len(files) dan semua SHA-256 valid pada phase_4_1_1_baseline_manifest.json (48 file) dan pre_patch_manifest.json (65 file).
regression_tests.test_method: Full disk file existence and SHA-256 recomputation check across all 48 + 65 backup artifacts.

regression_tests.name: Sensitivity Table Arithmetic
regression_tests.objective: Semua angka sensitivitas konsisten dengan script dan JSON sumber, termasuk dekomposisi skor RHSI_w vs skor berpenalti untuk Madidihang dan Legacy species removed from TCT scope.
regression_tests.test_method: Direct recomputation of lambda x tau grid and 5 weight schemes across 2,050 cells.

regression_tests.name: CITES & Bycatch Compliance
regression_tests.objective: 123 polygon kandidat terklip ketat, memiliki 8 field CITES, berstatus NEEDS_VERIFICATION, dan bernama Candidate Bathymetric Screening Polygons for Voluntary Shark Bycatch Review.

actual_value.official_name: Candidate Bathymetric Screening Polygons for Voluntary Shark Bycatch Review

regression_tests.test_method: Feature and property schema verification across all 123 polygons.

regression_tests.name: Dashboard & Bundle Integrity
regression_tests.objective: html/index.html, html/oceanographic_data.js, dan html/sdm_data.js bebas syntax error dan 100% sinkron dengan JSON sumber.
regression_tests.test_method: Node.js V8 syntax compilation of all inline scripts and runtime evaluation of window.ocean132Months, window.oceanCrossCorrelation, and window.sdmModelEvaluations.

phase_4_1_validation_checks.name: No synthetic fishing GPS & strict AOI clamping of background proxy points
phase_4_1_validation_checks.requirement: Zero synthetic or fabricated GPS catch coordinates generated from port landing data; heuristic presence-proxy and background points strictly inside Sub-AOI Prigi [111.00, 113.00] E x [-10.45, -8.00] S.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.test_method: Programmatic coordinate boundary check on target_group_background.geojson (5,000 points) and presence-proxy records (981 points).
phase_4_1_validation_checks.notes: All 5,000 background points strictly inside [111.0005, 112.9995] x [-10.4495, -8.0005] with 0 points outside AOI and 0 points piled on boundary lines.

phase_4_1_validation_checks.name: RHSI relative interpretation & honest heuristic algorithmic provenance
phase_4_1_validation_checks.requirement: All SDM outputs labeled as Relative Habitat Suitability Index (RHSI) or heuristic habitat screening on [0.00, 1.00]; no false claims of statistical ML training or spatial block cross-validation execution.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.test_method: JSON schema boolean assertion on ml_training_executed_in_code and spatial_cv_executed_in_code, plus UI string inspection in html/index.html.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.notes: Explicitly documents analytical Gaussian/step/logit heuristic curves and proxy-discrimination evaluation metrics.

phase_4_1_validation_checks.name: Ensemble weight normalization
phase_4_1_validation_checks.requirement: Individual heuristic component weights w_i satisfy w_i >= 0 and sum(w_i) = 1.000 across all M components for each species.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.test_method: Mathematical summation assertion on eval_sum[sp].ensemble.weights in model_evaluations_summary.json.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.notes: Canonical provisional weights (PROVISIONAL_ANALYST_SELECTED_WEIGHTS) sum to 1.000 for Cakalang (0.320+0.355+0.325), Madidihang (0.295+0.365+0.340), and Legacy species removed from TCT scope (0.000+0.517+0.483).

phase_4_1_validation_checks.name: Weighted ensemble disagreement (sigma_w) & dual-score advisory storage
phase_4_1_validation_checks.requirement: sigma_w computed strictly as sqrt(sum(w_i * (RHSI_i - RHSI_bar_w)^2)) where w_i=0 contributes 0; both raw_advisory_score (RHSI_bar_w - 0.5*sigma_w) and visualization_score (clipped [0,1]) stored per cell and displayed separately on UI.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.test_method: Cell-by-cell mathematical verification across all 6 scenarios x 3 species x 2,050 cells (36,900 records) and UI KPI element inspection.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.notes: Remediated CONF-10: Legacy species removed from TCT scope zero-weight component (hsi_maxent, w=0) no longer inflates sigma_w, and dual advisory scores are stored in every cell.

phase_4_1_validation_checks.name: Lambda penalty, weight scheme, and threshold sensitivity analysis
phase_4_1_validation_checks.requirement: Computational sensitivity analysis executed across lambda in {0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00}, 4 weight schemes, and exploratory thresholds tau in {0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70}.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.test_method: JSON verification of outputs/sdm/hsi/rhsi_sensitivity_analysis.json across 3 target species.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.notes: Full computational sensitivity matrix generated and persisted in outputs/sdm/hsi/rhsi_sensitivity_analysis.json.

phase_4_1_validation_checks.name: Internal maritime risk classification & safety label compliance
phase_4_1_validation_checks.requirement: Zero 'AMAN' / 'SAFE' guarantees or automated sea bans in baseline application; multivariate 4-tier maritime risk screening engine (Hs, wind speed, gust, freeboard, draft, worst-case trigger) scheduled for Phase 4.4.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.test_method: Regex scan of html/index.html and Python pages for prohibited 'AMAN'/'SAFE' guarantees or automated sea bans, plus architectural module check.
phase_4_1_validation_checks.notes: Status PARTIAL reflects that baseline UI complies with PROHIB-03 and PROHIB-04 (zero 'AMAN' guarantees or automated bans), while the interactive multivariate risk screening module is scoped for Phase 4.4.
